name: gpm-das-reconciler-benchmark
description: A dataset and benchmark for evaluating record/ entity reconciliation systems that match and merge records across data sources. It measures the ability of algorithms to correctly link equivalent entities and resolve conflicts in noisy, real-world text fields. Typical tasks include pairwise matching and canonicalization of records.
reputation: A small, specialized benchmark hosted on Hugging Face with limited but growing usage in record linkage and data-cleaning research communities.
